# Logic

Open a `.logic` file and press ▶: each expression gets its truth table (with a column per step), whether it is a tautology, contradiction or contingency, its minterms, and its sum-of-products / product-of-sums forms.

Expressions with the same table are listed as **equivalent**.

# A half adder and a full adder
Sum = A xor B
Carry = A and B

FullSum = A xor B xor Cin
FullCarry = (A and B) or (Cin and (A xor B))

# Truth tables update as you type (▶ or "Show Truth Tables").
# Operators: and & ∧  or | ∨  not ! ¬  xor ^ ⊕  -> →  <-> ↔  nand nor  constants 0 1 T F

# De Morgan's laws: F and G have the same table
F = not (A and B)
G = not A or not B

# Implication and its contrapositive (a tautology)
I = (p -> q) <-> (not q -> not p)

# Distributive law
D1 = A and (B or C)
D2 = (A and B) or (A and C)

# A contradiction
X = p and not p

# SQL with SQLite

▶ on a `.sql` file runs it in TMCode's built-in SQLite: every statement's result shows as a table beside the code, errors at their line.

- **Fresh each run** (default): a new database every time; `schema.sql` and `seed.sql` run first.
- **Keep data**: tables and rows stay between runs (Reset empties it).
- 💡 on a query shows how SQLite runs it (EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN).

-- ⌘/Ctrl+Shift+Enter runs the whole file; ⌘/Ctrl+Enter runs the query under the cursor.

-- 1. Everyone, best average first
SELECT s.name, s.class, ROUND(AVG(m.score), 1) AS average, COUNT(*) AS subjects
FROM students s
JOIN marks m ON m.student_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id
ORDER BY average DESC;

-- 2. The top mark in each subject
SELECT sub.title, st.name, m.score
FROM marks m
JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = m.subject_id
JOIN students st ON st.id = m.student_id
WHERE m.score = (SELECT MAX(score) FROM marks WHERE subject_id = m.subject_id);

-- 3. Who has no Physics mark? (LEFT JOIN … IS NULL)
SELECT s.name
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN marks m ON m.student_id = s.id AND m.subject_id = (SELECT id FROM subjects WHERE title = 'Physics')
WHERE m.student_id IS NULL;

-- 4. Class averages with a window function
SELECT DISTINCT s.class, ROUND(AVG(m.score) OVER (PARTITION BY s.class), 1) AS class_average
FROM students s JOIN marks m ON m.student_id = s.id;
